title: My Mall World Dreams
content: Hi everyone, so glad to find this sub. I often have dreams in a really long, bright mall that I often get lost in. The store fronts are sometimes selfie attractions, SEARS, candy stores, hip toy stores, and an ice cream shop. Attached to it is a senior center where I often visit a client that I used to work with IRL. The hallways are all beige, and there are a lot of doors on a lot of floors that all look similar. The elevators will often go to the incorrect floor. Also, in the mall, the bathrooms are really strange. They're often a large, shared room, with doors that go from ankle to chest height, so that even when you're sitting down everyone can make eye contact with each other. Sometimes there are no doors on the stalls at all, and everyone is facing each other on toilets. l
